purpose: Decompose a worker launch into observable stages so failures can be located and improved without changing the whole worker at once.
global_law: Optimize the pipeline stage that is actually weak. Do not compensate for a weak entry/decision stage by launching more workers, and do not let experiments reduce product completion.

stages.name: Interpret launch envelope
stages.goal: Resolve NEW/RESUME, run_id/pool/batch, authorization and exact first durable action before consulting historical worker evidence.
stages.hard_rule: For NEW launches, historical identity/result reuse is forbidden.

stages.name: Fresh identity
stages.goal: Create fresh worker_id + launch_nonce and atomically CREATE own beacon.
stages.hard_rule: Beacon is the first durable worker write.

stages.name: Unique assignment
stages.goal: In RUN mode atomically self-claim one compatible launch slot; otherwise use the normal allocator.
stages.hard_rule: One RUN slot has at most one owner; human does not number or route slots.

stages.name: Exact context load
stages.goal: Read only the assigned long capsule/exact sources needed to execute the owned objective.
stages.hard_rule: No broad project archaeology before the packet/capsule proves it necessary.

stages.name: Execution lock
stages.goal: Convert the objective into a small actionable contract tied to hard gates before large implementation work.
stages.hard_rule: Planning is bounded and must immediately lead to implementation; no status-only plan.

stages.name: Production
stages.goal: Implement the entire owned objective through its definition of done, not just the first edit.
stages.hard_rule: Do not stop at first commit/checkpoint when executable acceptance work remains.

stages.name: Verification
stages.goal: Build and maintain an explicit evidence map from every required feature/hard gate to the exact check/artifact that proves it, then run available static/runtime/browser/public checks and close only when every row is PASS or a truthful capability/authority BOUNDARY.
stages.hard_rule: Evidence-map-first verification is baseline: every owned objective must know what proves each hard gate before close. Never claim a check that was not executed. A separate second acceptance pass is optional reinforcement for high-risk/ambiguous work, not mandatory baseline.
stages.evidence: evidence map + executed tests + receipt feature_evidence

confirmed_optional_law.trigger: high-risk, ambiguous, safety/authority-sensitive, externally brittle, or evidence-map rows whose first pass remains uncertain
confirmed_optional_law.rule: Run a separate acceptance pass from the original owned contract without relying on the implementation summary; repair all found misses before RETURN.

stages.name: Durable return
stages.goal: Persist the primary result/evidence so another actor can reconstruct what changed. A transport denial must remain explicit and must not erase already durable production/verification evidence.
stages.hard_rule: No terminal human answer before durable RETURN/guide receipt when the scope is executable. For non-RUN BATCH/POOL only: if an explicit tool/connector safety denial proves the canonical RETURN/guide receipt was NOT persisted after E5 and E6 completed, never retry or bypass the denied operation/path. If a separate permitted transport-boundary receipt is durably persisted with exact authority_ref, started_ref and completed evidence refs, keep E7=BOUNDARY and allow only E8 continuation to unrelated compatible work. The blocked unit does not count as productive, prior authority is not released, and the blocked job remains recovery debt.
stages.evidence: RETURN/guide receipt; or explicit transport-boundary receipt proving non-persistence plus exact authority/STARTED/product/test evidence (BOUNDARY only, never PASS)

transport_continuation.continuation: E7 remains BOUNDARY; worker may enter E8 and claim unrelated compatible work under the same fresh worker_id. Old job stays immutable/recovery-bound until normal recovery resolves the missing RETURN.
transport_continuation.run_mode: DISALLOWED_UNLESS_PACKET_EXPLICITLY_AUTHORIZES; default RUN behavior remains terminal boundary

stages.name: Autonomous reallocation
stages.goal: After a counted RETURN, or after an explicitly evidenced non-RUN E7 transport boundary that permits continuation, take a compatible unrelated objective without new human routing.
stages.hard_rule: Primary completion is not terminal in graduation RUNs. In ordinary BATCH/POOL, an E7 transport-boundary continuation never counts the blocked unit and must not touch the still-owned blocked target; it only preserves resident capacity for unrelated compatible work.
stages.evidence: reallocation claim + next-objective evidence; when entered from E7 BOUNDARY also cite the exact transport-boundary receipt

stages.name: Exam and close
stages.goal: Write one structured exam/benchmark receipt exposing stage outcomes and only then close when the run contract permits.
stages.hard_rule: The exam reports failures; it does not excuse them or manufacture evidence.

timing.clock: durable artifact timestamps when available; worker-authored timestamps otherwise are diagnostic only

experiment_boundary: Future evolution rounds may vary one stage rule at a time. Identity, authority, safety, benchmark objective, hard gates and evidence truth remain invariant. V3_EVIDENCE_MAP is the frozen E6 baseline after CATLAB-P2B-01; future experiments compare against it rather than the former direct-control E6.
